answer.text: Fill the tank only up to the bottom of the anti splash plate.
Do not overfill the fuel tank.

watchouts.text: Overfilling may let gasoline enter the EVAP canister and damage the evaporative emission system.
Gasoline vapour is highly explosive. Make sure there are no open flames or sparks nearby, and fill only in a well-ventilated area.
Wipe up any fuel spilled on painted surfaces immediately, as it may leave a permanent stain.
Do not smoke while refuelling or when the fuel tank cap is open.
